keyEvents.text: Goal! Brest 1, Lyon 0. Noah Edjouma (Brest) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kamory Doumbia.
Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Lyon. Mads Bidstrup replaces Noah Nartey.
Kaïl Boudache (Lyon) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Brest. Pathé Mboup replaces Mama Baldé.
Substitution, Brest. Giovani Versini replaces Noah Edjouma.
Substitution, Lyon. Ernest Nuamah replaces Kaïl Boudache.
Substitution, Lyon. Abner Vinícius replaces Nicolás Tagliafico.
Substitution, Brest. Mamady Diambou replaces Kamory Doumbia.
Substitution, Lyon. Julien Duranville replaces Keito Nakamura.
Substitution, Lyon. Alejandro Gomes Rodríguez replaces Khalis Merah.
Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Brest 2, Lyon 0. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the high centre of the goal.
